items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 12 June 2026 11:34am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 12 June 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland, while a weak frontal zone continues to clear the area this afternoon.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 4 or 5 occasionally 6, veering West 5 or 6 this evening, occasionally touching 7 in the east of the area.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, with a risk of isolated showers tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Westerly 5 or 6, decreasing 3 to 5 tomorrow afternoon, then veering Northwest in the evening. Becoming North or Northwest 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers tomorrow morning, becoming fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any showers.
